reviews.comment: DO NOT TAKE THIS PROF! There's a ton of homework, attendance is mandatory but lectures are super boring. He pushes his political agenda on his students all semester. He's such a tough and confusing grader. Class averages on assignments are so low. He isn't considerate or willing to help students out when they ask him questions. Don't take him.
reviews.ratingTags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Participation matters

reviews.comment: Mr. Riggins is pretty chill. The class is kinda boring, but I wouldn't say that that's his fault. Writing about literature is a hard subject to get people engaged in, but I think he does a good job of creating an environment for meaningful discussion. Attendance is part of the grade, but its overall weight is very low.

The class material over violence was interesting, especially the novels. He had a monotone voice which made the lectures a little hard to engage in. Lots of participation is mandatory, but class discussion was great! No exams; just essays, homework assignments, and seminar-esque projects.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: He was an awful instructor. He was so strict on grading, and it was hard to know what you got points taken off for. He basically gives you better grades if you participate more in class and if he likes you. He would call on people in class and if you didn't know the answer, he would embarrass you. His class was boring, but attendance is required.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Participation matters in this class so get ready to read and discuss. Attendance is important, so use your 3 free passes wisely, or you'll drop down a letter grade.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Forced participation and close-minded when listening to other people's opinions and interpretations. Super monotone and lectures were hard to engage with. Have to read and be caught up or embarrass yourself when he calls on you in class!
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Mr. Riggins isn't the best teacher, but he's not bad. His class is extremely boring. However, I never read any of the things we discussed and did perfectly fine. His grading can be unpredictable, especially if he gets annoyed with you. Just make sure to be on time for class and participate pretty often and you'll be fine. Super easy class.
reviews.ratingTags: Gives good feedback--Participation matters--Graded by few things
